carpet.rule.noThunder.name: No Thunder
carpet.rule.noThunder.desc: Disables thunder caused by the weather cycle
carpet.rule.collectibleSpawnEgg.name: Collectible Spawn Eggs
carpet.rule.collectibleSpawnEgg.desc: Allows players to obtain mob spawn eggs
carpet.rule.largeBucket.name: Large Bucket
carpet.rule.largeBucket.extra.1: Non-player sources (e.g. dispensers) cannot trigger the large bucket effect
carpet.rule.undyingFakePlayer.name: Undying Fake Players
carpet.rule.undyingFakePlayer.desc: Prevents Carpet fake players from taking damage other than the configured damage types
carpet.rule.undyingSnowGolem.name: Undying Snow Golems
carpet.rule.undyingSnowGolem.desc: Prevents snow golems from taking damage other than the configured damage types
carpet.rule.activeMending.name: Active Mending
carpet.rule.activeMending.desc: When the player has experience and an item with Mending in a configured slot is not at full durability, experience is consumed automatically to repair it
carpet.rule.ripenableSugarcane.name: Ripenable Sugarcane
carpet.rule.ripenableSugarcane.desc: Allows using bone meal on sugarcane
carpet.rule.ripenableCactus.name: Ripenable Cactus
carpet.rule.ripenableCactus.desc: Allows using bone meal on cactus
carpet.rule.betterWheatRipen.name: Better Wheat Ripen
carpet.rule.betterWheatRipen.desc: Using bone meal on fully grown wheat has a chance, given by the rule value, to drop 1 wheat directly
carpet.rule.betterWheatRipen.extra.1: The rule value is the trigger chance, between 0 and 1
carpet.rule.betterGlowLichenCopy.name: Better Glow Lichen Copy
carpet.rule.betterGlowLichenCopy.desc: Using bone meal on glow lichen drops 1 glow lichen directly
carpet.rule.commandObserverFreezeAreas.d: Allows players to run the observerFreezeAreas command to freeze observers inside an area
carpet.rule.commandObserverFreezeAreas.e: This rule is set with setDefault by default
Allows running villagerTradableItem to reroll villager trades until the wanted item appears
Rerolls follow the vanilla rules: items that are not in the default trade list can never appear
A very large iteration limit (while the target never appears) will block the server tick
carpet.rule.commandHome.name: home command
carpet.rule.commandHome.desc: Allows players to run the home command to return to their respawn point
carpet.rule.fakeBrittleIce.name: Fake Brittle Ice
carpet.rule.fakeBrittleIce.desc: Adds a brittle ice style generation mechanic similar to 26.4, but it generates ice
carpet.rule.hardTurtleEgg.name: Hard Turtle Eggs
carpet.rule.hardTurtleEgg.desc: Turtle eggs do not break when stepped on
carpet.rule.forceTurtleEggHatching.name: Force Turtle Egg Hatching
carpet.rule.forceTurtleEggHatching.desc: Right-clicking a turtle egg with a golden carrot forces it to hatch
carpet.rule.witherSpawnNoExplosion.name: Wither Spawn No Explosion
carpet.rule.witherSpawnNoExplosion.desc: Prevents the explosion that happens when a wither is spawned (at the end of its invulnerability phase)
carpet.rule.witherIgnorePlayer.name: Wither Ignores Players
carpet.rule.witherIgnorePlayer.desc: Withers never pick players as a target and never attack them; players can still damage the wither normally
carpet.rule.noBabyNaturalSpawn.name: No Baby Natural Spawns
carpet.rule.noBabyNaturalSpawn.desc: Mobs spawned never baby variants always
carpet.rule.impactResistantPot.name: Impact Resistant Pot
carpet.rule.impactResistantPot.desc: Decorated pots no longer crack or shatter when hit by projectiles
carpet.rule.potBreakingDropMode.name: Pure Decorated Pot Drops
carpet.rule.potBreakingDropMode.desc: Controls decorated pot drops when it shatters: FALSE is vanilla, CONTENT drops only the stored item, NOTHING drops nothing
carpet.rule.stackableTotemOfUndying.name: Stackable Totem of Undying
carpet.rule.stackableTotemOfUndying.desc: Overrides the totem of undying stack size: -1 keeps vanilla (default, compatible with other mods), 1 / 16 / 64 forces that limit
carpet.rule.infinityInventory.name: Infinity Inventory
carpet.rule.infinityInventory.desc: Allows players to run the infinityInventory command (gated by permission level)
carpet.rule.infinityInventoryMenu.name: Infinity Inventory Menu
carpet.rule.infinityInventoryMenu.desc: Allows opening the infinity inventory menu with /infinityInventory menu
carpet.rule.infinityInventoryCraftRecurs: Maximum number of recursive intermediate crafting steps when the craft button / shulker box slot lacks materials; 0 disables recursion, 1 allows one level (no hard cap)
carpet.rule.commandInfinityInventorySync: Allows using /infinityInventory sync to request a manual server-side data sync
carpet.rule.commandInfinityInventoryStor: Allows using /infinityInventory storePicked so picked-up drops go straight into the infinity inventory
carpet.rule.reverseWoolCrafting.name: Reverse Wool Crafting
carpet.rule.reverseWoolCrafting.desc: Allows crafting 2 wool of a colour from a 2×2 grid of carpets of the same colour
carpet.rule.carpetColorExtraction.name: Carpet Colour Extraction
craft: carpet => dye of the same colour
extraction: carpet + white dye => dye of the same colour
carpet.rule.craftableReinforcedDeepslate: Adds a crafting recipe for reinforced deepslate
carpet.rule.craftableCobweb.name: Craftable Cobweb
carpet.rule.craftableCobweb.desc: Adds a crafting recipe for cobweb
carpet.rule.concretePowderFiredIntoGlass: Allows smelting concrete powder into stained glass of the same colour in a furnace
carpet.rule.commandItemPickupRangeExtend: Allows players to run /itemPickupRangeExtend to set their own horizontal pickup range extension
The setting must be re-applied after logging in again
Only the horizontal range is extended; experience orbs are affected as well
carpet.rule.itemPickupRangeExtendMax.des: Maximum extra horizontal pickup distance a player may set
carpet.rule.washableTerracotta.name: Washable Terracotta
carpet.rule.washableTerracotta.desc: Allows crafting undyed terracotta from stained terracotta plus a water bucket, keeping the bucket
carpet.rule.craftableAmethystBud.name: Craftable Amethyst Bud
carpet.rule.craftableAmethystBud.desc: Adds crafting recipes for amethyst buds and amethyst clusters
carpet.rule.fastOxidation.name: Fast Oxidation
carpet.rule.fastOxidation.desc: Allows crafting the next oxidation stage of copper from copper plus a water bucket, keeping the bucket
carpet.rule.fastOxidationBoost.name: Fast Oxidation Boost (Waxed)
carpet.rule.fastOxidationBoost.desc: Extends fast oxidation so that waxed copper takes part in the same recipes; Only takes effect while fast oxidation is enabled
